description: NATIONAL TREASURE recognised in 2015; hung in the main entrance hall of the new museum rather than parked outside; carries fourteen victory stars for fourteen US aircraft shot down during 1967 by nine different pilots of the 921st Fighter Regiment including Le Trong Huyen; Pham Thanh Ngan; Nguyen Hong Nhi; Nguyen Van Coc and Nguyen Dang Kinh who each scored twice in it; Vietnamese sources designate it MiG-21 F-94 which is a local variant label not a Soviet one so the variant field is left blank
aliases: MiG21; MiG-21F-94; MiG21F94; F-94; 4324; Fishbed; F94
museum_name: Bao tang Lich su Quan su Viet Nam (Vietnam Military History Museum) -- Hanoi

description: NATIONAL TREASURE; flown by Pham Tuan on the night of 27 December 1972 when he shot down a B-52 -- the only fighter in the world credited with destroying a B-52 using air-to-air missiles; the same airframe accounted for four further US aircraft; displayed in the anti-American resistance gallery; Vietnamese sources designate it MiG-21 F-96 which is a local variant label so the variant field is left blank
aliases: MiG21; MiG-21F-96; MiG21F96; F-96; 5121; Fishbed; F96
